VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the buffer allocator's init function as installing its own wrappers via the runtime setter, and says the library ships exactly one such allocator. It doesn't name the MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C macro, but the mechanism and location are stated.
